# netactuate_storage_buckets (Data Source)

Reads Storage Buckets visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_storage_buckets" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (List of Object) Storage buckets visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
